title: Sunset Lines: The Story of the Chicago Aurora & Elgin Railroad - Trackage
author: Larry Plachno
description: This book is volume one in a series, which provides an in-depth review and documentation on the routes, operations, trackage, equipment, and history of the Chicago Aurora & Elgin Railroad. It includes detailed track maps, over 190 photos (many in full color), and covers significant advancements such as powerful electric passenger cars.
